1225435.name: Bountiful Harvest
1225435.desc: You discover 100% more Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning.

1225451.name: Working Overtime
1225451.desc: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 10%.

1225455.name: Luremaster
1225455.desc: While fishing with a Lure active, you have a 50% chance to catch an extra fish.

1225456.name: Performance Bonus
1225456.desc: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

1225457.name: Master Chef
1225457.desc: Your cooking recipes have a 30% chance to create an extra result.

1225459.name: Bartering
1225459.desc: Reduces the gold price of items from all vendors by 10%.

1225469.name: Dedicated Study
1225469.desc: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.

1225472.name: Thrill of Adventure
1225472.desc: You gain 5% of your maximum Health and Mana over 10 sec each time you deliver the killing blow to a non-trivial enemy. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

1225474.name: Talented
1225474.desc: You gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

1225475.name: Field Medicine
1225475.desc: Reduces the duration of the Recently Bandaged effect by 10 sec when you use a bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

1225477.name: High Alert
1225477.desc: Increases your ability to detect nearby targets with Stealth as if your level were increased by 2. Ineffective in Battlegrounds.

1225478.name: Well Rested
1225478.desc: Your rested experience accumulates 20% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 20%.

1225479.name: Field Guide
1225479.desc: Reduces your cooldown on adding Camp features by 25%

1225490.name: Frequent Flier
1225490.desc: You receive a 50% discount on all flight paths, and your flight path mount flies 20% faster.

1225497.name: Reinforce
1225497.desc: You take 20% less durability loss when you die.

1225499.name: Gourmand
1225499.desc: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 100%.

1225500.name: The Quick and the Dead
1225500.desc: Increases movement speed while dead by 10% and your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 2 min after being resurrected or until you enter combat.

1225502.name: Permanence
1225502.desc: Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer.

1225503.name: Reagent Economy
1225503.desc: Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchaseable from vendors.
